title: Weekly Mixed-Mode Distance Stack
dataSources: E-bike rides (`ebike:ride`), scooter trips (`scooter:trip`), skate sessions (`skate:session`), surf sessions (`surf:session`), snow runs (`snow:run`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sport trackers — e-bike / e-scooter apps (VanMoof, Bosch eBike Flow), and skate / surf / snow session trackers (Trace, Slopes, Xensr) with IMU sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=ebike:ride OR sourcetype=scooter:trip)
| eval mode=if(sourcetype="ebike:ride","e-bike","e-scooter")
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(distance_km) as distance_km by _time mode
| sort - _time
description: Stacks weekly distance across the micro-mobility modes you actually use.
value: A weekly distance split makes mode share tangible and highlights what is replacing short car trips.
implementation: Collect e-bike and scooter trip distances in `index=personal`; summarize weekly totals by mode.
visualization: Stacked weekly column chart of micro-mobility distance by mode.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how your weekly distance is split across bikes and scooters instead of guessing which one you use more.
